provider: ATR/BPN BHUMI and ATLAS national geospatial portal

schemaAndCrs: Layer metadata exposes safe display fields penggunaan, tipehak, luas, nib, akurasibidang. CRS and geometry type were not confirmed because the public OWS route returned application HTML/unusable output.
nativeIdentity: nib (Nomor Identifikasi Bidang) is the documented preferred native identity. No synthetic identity, OBJECTID, or composite key was used.

fieldMapping.nib: canonical native parcel identity if independently retrieved
fieldMapping.geometry: parcel polygon geometry if independently retrieved

requestOutcome: Official landing, map, catalog, and anonymous published-layer metadata requests succeeded. Anonymous WFS capabilities and bounded geometry requests did not yield usable service responses. Exact WUP point was not treated as a negative result.
retainedProperties: No GeoJSON retained because no safe native-ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.
unsafeDataPolicy: Owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, legal-description, and rights-detail fields were not requested or retained.
officialCustodyEvidence: ATR/BPN official BHUMI/ATLAS documentation and live published layer metadata evidence a national cadastral map service. A distinct local Kantor Pertanahan Buleleng custodian/API was not located.
limits: National layer metadata does not prove complete Singaraja coverage.
No exact-point feature response was available; this is not evidence of citywide absence.
The public OWS route may be UI-proxied, changed, or require a map-session route; no login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS exception was used.

uncertainty: Independent review must confirm the current anonymous feature endpoint, CRS handling, Singaraja coverage, NIB stability, and adapter safety before admission.
